evidentiary_meaning: This proves that, as of the LATER gen-2 capture-dry-run observation (2026-07-11T19:48:06Z), the specific fields listed above were still identical to the values recorded in gen-1's hash-attested input snapshots (captured 2026-07-11T17:42:15Z). It is evidence of NO DRIFT between gen-1 time and the gen-2 observation for these fields. It is NOT proof that gen-1's original capture-and-write was itself correct at gen-1 capture time: gen-1's own deployment-manifest.json output is not committed in this bundle (only its sha256, attestation.json.manifest_gen1_sha256, is recorded), so this comparison uses gen-1's INPUT snapshots as the left side, not a re-run of gen-1's own manifest-generation output. A later recapture agreeing with earlier inputs is not the same claim as a later recapture reproducing the earlier host state.
